import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD1 = 998244353;
    static final int MOD2 = 1000000007;
    static final int BASE_VAL = 1000000;
    static List<Integer>[] data = new ArrayList[7];
    static int[] prefixSumData = new int[7];
    static long limitN;
    static long countTotal = 0;
    static long answerTotal = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            data[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void buildTree(int level, int prefix) {
        countTotal++;
        int val = (int)((countTotal - prefix + MOD1) % MOD1);
        data[level].add(val);
        prefixSumData[level] = (int)((prefixSumData[level] + val) % MOD2);
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            buildTree(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void traverseNumber(long x) {
        if (x > limitN) return;
        if (x * BASE_VAL + BASE_VAL - 1 <= limitN && x * BASE_VAL * 10 > limitN) {
            long currentCount = countTotal;
            for (int i = 0, factor = 1; i <= 6; i++, factor *= 10) {
                int size = data[i].size();
                int diffVal = (int)(((currentCount - x * factor) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                int pos = lowerBound(data[i], MOD1 - diffVal);
                answerTotal = (answerTotal + (long)diffVal * size + prefixSumData[i]) % MOD2;
                answerTotal = (answerTotal - (long)MOD1 * (size - pos) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2;
                countTotal += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        countTotal++;
        answerTotal = (answerTotal + ((countTotal - x) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1) % MOD2;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            traverseNumber(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        limitN = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        buildTree(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(data[i]);
        }
        countTotal = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverseNumber(i);
        }
        System.out.println(answerTotal);
    }
}
